note: Forms of the bridges of Nanjing, December 1937 (wave 3d, bridges area). Joined to public/nanjing/bridges.json by NAME AND POSITION (src/world/nanjing/bridges/table.js): a `named` entry takes the record in `ids` if it lies within 60 m of `at`, else the nearest record within 40 m; unnamed records get a form by rule (C.2 of city/WATER_LOOK_SPEC.md; thresholds in table.js, `rules` here). `additions` are bridges the 1945 sheet's roads did not carry across the water (spec C.1); each stands where the ground says there is water. Every `evidence` string says what is 核实 (read in a source), 推测 (inferred) or 未核实 (nothing found). `form.klass` is the class the walkers' deck reckoning uses (stone_arch | beam | slab): it stays the record's own unless said (see FILM_CONTRACT); `drawArches` changes only what is drawn under the deck. Wave 5 (11-10): `useRealWidths` is true (the people area reads ctx.shared.bridgeRecords); unnamed 1930s road bridges by rule are drawn 23 m wide (`rules.rcDeckMax`, spec C.2: 16-23 m); an entry may carry `bySpan: [{maxSpan, form}]` (the form for the channel's width: the table-C forms are for the narrowed canals); records with no water in public/ortho/nanjing1937/water_map.png are not drawn (`dropDry: false` turns that off, `keepDry` on a form keeps one).

named.evidence: 65 x 22.7 m reinforced concrete, built 1928-11-16 to 1929-05-23 (zh.wikipedia 中山桥): 核实. Beam or arch 未核实 (beam on piers every 14.5 m: 推测). Balustrade 1.0 m and lamp standards each 25 m: 推测 (spec C.1). Intact in December 1937. Wave 5: 2.6 m cast-flag footways 0.07 m over a 0.28 m granite kerb, a lighter dusty-tar carriageway, expansion-joint strips over each pier, balusters 0.45 m apart, end pylons, a cornice over the girder faces: all 推测 (no source found for the bridge's balustrade or lamps; a search for 中山桥 惠民河 1929 栏杆 路灯 returned nothing on the Nanjing bridge).

Five-arch stone bridge (无铰五孔石拱桥) 51 x 12.4 m, humped bluestone, parapets 0.5 m (zh.wikipedia 九龙桥 (南京)): 核实. One section was bombed in 1937 (date 未核实; the arch counted second from the south end and the evening of 12 Dec are 推测). Concrete rail is 1949+: not drawn.

Two stone arches before 1949, just north of the 中华门 barbican (zh.wikipedia 镇淮桥): 核实. Deck 12-14 m: 推测 (26.2 m is the 1960 bridge). The deck stays level at the record's beam crown (so the walkers' reckoning holds), the two arches are drawn under it: 推测. No 牌楼 (1937 未核实). Wave 5 fallback: if the water build leaves no record within 40 m of `at` (it did at 14:33Z: the canal there is dashed in the new water), the bridge is drawn from `fallback` (the old record's place and direction, a span of 26 m: 推测, the spec's 20-30 m for these canals).

Exists (K, csdata1937: 47 m from the record). Low level bridge 20-25 x 6-8 m on stone abutments and one or two piers, timber or stone beams, low plain parapet: 推测 (two secondary sources disagree: 1931 rebuild vs timber on stone piers). The model's channel is 88 m (real: about 20 m): the bridge spans what the water is and gets piers every 9 m; it follows the channel when the water area narrows it. Wave 5: a channel of 40 m or less (the spec says 35; the new water there is 34-37 m) (the narrowed canal: spec C.1) gets the low level bridge, 20-25 m on stone abutments and 1-2 piers (bay 9 m); a channel that stays wider gets a timber trestle (the spec's fallback, 推测).

Exists (K). A single low segmental stone arch 25-30 x 6 m (spec C.1, 推测): drawn as arches of about 24 m under the record's level deck because the model's channel is 54 m. Wave 5: a channel of 34 m or less gets the spec's single low segmental arch (25-30 m x 6 m; low because the deck is level at the record's beam crown, so the rise is what fits under it); a wider one two arches of about 24 m. Wave 5 fallback: if the water build leaves no record within 40 m of `at` (it did at 14:33Z: the canal there is dashed in the new water), the bridge is drawn from `fallback` (the old record's place and direction, a span of 28 m: 推测, the spec's 20-30 m for these canals).
